Effort simplesalt/projects#978, How task T5 (agentdb Helm chart, simplesalt/oci). Desired state: installing the agentdb chart gives a release its database plus the two Python MCPs, admin and project, each usable by the callers granted it. A release keeps its project tool code in its own database unless its values name an MCP code OCI layer, in which case that code runs and code changes through the admin MCP are refused. Nothing in the release namespace can reach outside it, and the only way in is the two MCPs. The Go server and its generic and per-table data tools are gone.

Effort simplesalt/projects#978, How task T7 (agentdb admin MCP, simplesalt/oci). Desired state: an agent that follows only the admin MCP's coaching ends up with project tools that work at call time against the data library as it really is, and with the recovery tools a project needs (what changed, restore, undo by work item), since recovery is reachable only through project tools.
